status.evidence: FleetGS is an active UK fleet management platform specializing in telematics and DVSA compliance, as confirmed by its official website overview.

claims.claim: The company reports that its software platform integrates directly with physical GPS devices including RAM Tracking and Teltonika hardware, or can operate via phone-based tracking using a driver's smartphone to capture live vehicle tracking data.
The company markets a specific hardware offering, the FleetGS FMT100 GPS vehicle tracker, which includes an integrated SIM card to support live tracking across its fleet deployments.
claims.note: No published source mentions FleetGS marketing a specific hardware offering named the 'FleetGS FMT100 GPS vehicle tracker' with an integrated SIM card.

claims.claim: The company announced the release of its mobile application on the Apple App Store in October 2025 to enable digital vehicle inspections, driver compliance tracking, and job workforce management.
claims.note: The specific release month of October 2025 is unconfirmed by official sources, despite the mobile application being active on the Apple App Store.

claims.claim: Commercial sales channels show direct integration capabilities with specific hardware models, such as the FleetGS FMT100 GPS vehicle tracker and the Teltonika FMC920 4G LTE GPS tracker pre-configured for the UK FleetGS platform.
claims.corrected: Commercial sales channels show direct integration capabilities with specific hardware models, such as the Teltonika FMC880, FMC920 & FMC150 pre-configured for the UK FleetGS platform.
claims.note: The platform supports generic Teltonika hardware models like FMC880, FMC920, and FMC150 rather than a proprietary 'FleetGS FMT100' or pre-configured 'Teltonika FMC920 4G LTE' directly marketed by FleetGS.

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform features configurable privacy windows that can pause driver tracking outside of working hours to ensure legitimate fleet data use and registration with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO).

The company reports that its platform accommodates unlimited vehicles on a single dashboard and scales for operations running between 5 and 50 vehicles, as stated in its corporate promotional publications.

The company reports serving small to medium businesses in the UK managing fleets, drivers, staff, and jobs, with current regional customers operating from Sheffield city centre, Sheffield S1–S35 postcodes, Rotherham, and the M18 corridor.

FleetGS operates an affiliate partner programme that offers fleet consultants, transport advisors, vehicle telematics installers, resellers, and commercial lease brokers a recurring 25% monthly revenue share alongside a 10% customer discount.
claims.note: The inclusion of "commercial lease brokers" as eligible affiliates is unconfirmed in the program list (which specifies commercial vehicle dealers and lease brokers instead).

claims.claim: FleetGS maintains baseline hardware integration partnerships allowing customers to directly connect pre-installed vehicle hardware trackers from RAM Tracking, Teltonika, or Geotab straight to its fleet software platform.
The company reports that its software architecture is designed to scale with operators handling between 5 and 500 vehicles on a single centralized dashboard.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its software architecture is designed to scale with operators handling between 5 and 50 vehicles on a single centralized dashboard.

claims.claim: The company reports providing customer support for UK-based fleets from Monday to Friday, 8am to 6pm, with a response time within one business day, according to the official FleetGS website.

status.owner: Constellation Software Inc. (via Brillian UK Limited / Omegro Group)
status.evidence: According to Companies House filings and press releases, Trakm8 Limited remains active and was acquired by Brillian UK Limited (part of the Omegro Group under Constellation Software Inc.) via a court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement that became effective on 9 July 2025.

claims.claim: The company reports that its RH800 connected MDVR hardware integrates with its Insight platform to deliver server data updates every 15 seconds.
The company reports that its fleet tracking hardware models, including the Connect 200, Connect 330, and Connect 430, transmit real-time location data over cellular networks every 60 seconds.

In a case study published by Trakm8 Limited, Global Service Group deployed the company's Route Monkey software for last-mile residential flower deliveries, achieving a 20% fleet mileage savings on its flower contract and 15% to 18% savings across other contracts.
claims.source: Trakm8 Global Service Group Case Study (https://www.trakm8.com/case-studies/global-service-group/)

claims.claim: In a utility sector deployment, ScottishPower deployed Trakm8 Limited's in-cab driver feedback device across its heavy goods vehicle and light commercial vehicle fleet, achieving a 10% increase in fleet fuel economy and a 19% reduction in engine idling in its first year of use.

Autoglass deployed Trakm8's Connect 330 plug-in OBD device and RoadHawk Dash Cam across its commercial vehicle fleet starting in 2018, reducing average vehicle idle time by 50% within two years, according to an Insurance Edge case study.
The AA deployed Trakm8’s self-fit OBD port dongle hardware for its AA Fleet Intelligence system, saving £1 million on fuel bills during the first year of deployment, according to a Trakm8 case study.

Trakm8 Limited achieved formal ISO 27001 accreditation and upgraded its IT platform security to implement GDPR management processes and enhanced encrypted telematics products, as reported in a company publication detailing regulatory driver data adjustments.
claims.note: The details regarding upgrading the IT platform security specifically to implement GDPR management processes and the specific mention of a company publication detailing regulatory driver data adjustments are unverified.

claims.claim: Trakm8 Limited published official Statements of Compliance for its telematics and radio hardware models—including the Connect 200, Connect 330, and ACC750 devices—verifying conformance to the cybersecurity standards of ETSI EN 303 645 under the UK Product Security and Telecommunications Infrastructure Regulations.

The company reports its Trakm8 Insight platform features an Open API architecture and a modular ecosystem that includes low-level vehicle routing algorithms, energy APIs, and specific integration endpoints for ERP and Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) workflows.
claims.note: The specific product descriptions stating that the platform includes 'low-level vehicle routing algorithms, energy APIs, and specific integration endpoints for ERP' are unverified.

claims.claim: The Fuel Store partnered with Trakm8 to fully integrate its fleet fuel card services into Trakm8's Insight telematics platform, enabling enterprise fleets to match transaction data directly with vehicle telemetry feeds.
STARK UK upgraded to the Trakm8 Insight Platform under a three-year agreement to manage a fleet of 1,450 vehicles across more than 500 branches, extending a partnership that began in 2011.
Selco Builders Warehouse renewed its 10-year fleet telematics contract with the company to deploy the Trakm8 Insight Business Platform across its company car operations.
claims.corrected: Selco Builders Warehouse renewed its fleet telematics contract with the company for four years, marking a 10-year partnership, to deploy the Trakm8 Insight Business Platform across its company car operations.
claims.note: The contract renewal was for a four-year period (marking a 10-year overall partnership), not a 10-year contract renewal.
claims.source: Trakm8 Official News Release & Fleet News

claims.claim: In its final financial results for the year ended 31 March 2024, the company reported total revenue of £15.9 million, noting that its fleet software revenues were heavily impacted and down by £1.5 million due to the timing of renewals with UK retailers.
claims.corrected: In its final financial results for the year ended 31 March 2024, the company reported total revenue of £16.09 million, noting that its fleet software revenues were heavily impacted and down by £1.5 million due to the timing of renewals with UK retailers.
claims.note: The reported total revenue for the year ended 31 March 2024 was £16.09 million (£16,088k), not £15.9 million. Additionally, specific details regarding a £1.5 million drop in fleet software revenues due to UK retailer renewal timings are unverified in published summaries.
claims.source: Trakm8 Holdings PLC H1 2024 Interim Results Statement & London Stock Exchange Filings

claims.claim: In its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2024, the company reports that Fleet & Optimisation revenues grew 25% to £6.16 million (up from £4.91 million in the corresponding prior period), which included £1.84 million in software revenues following contract renewals with Iceland and Sainsbury's.
claims.source: Trakm8 Holdings PLC H1 2024 Interim Results Statement (December 2024)

claims.claim: Lookers Leasing agreed to a partnership with Trakm8 in June 2024 to supply its corporate fleet customers with Trakm8's telematics technology, Connectedcare vehicle health insights, and the RH600 4G integrated telematics camera, as reported by Business Car.

Arnold Clark Vehicle Management announced a partnership with Trakm8 to offer the company's range of telematics and vehicle camera solutions, including its self-install T10 Micro device, as a value-add proposition to its contract hire and leasing customers, as reported by Trakm8.

The company reports that it has over 240,000 active connections in operation across its fleet management, insurance, automotive, and optimization sectors, according to its June 2026 annual report announcement.
claims.corrected: The company reports that it has over 240,000 active connections in operation across its fleet management, insurance, automotive, and optimization sectors, according to its July 2026 AGM announcement.

claims.claim: The company reports that its dedicated fleet management business unit accounted for 69,000 active connections out of a total base of 348,000 connections, as disclosed in its March 2023 annual report.

Trakm8 Limited operates two primary physical facilities in the UK, maintaining its corporate headquarters and a specialized hardware manufacturing facility in Coleshill (Birmingham), alongside an additional office located in Shaftesbury, Dorset.

The company provides a dedicated customer support team reachable via phone and email from its UK offices, offering standard response coverage from 07:00 to 18:00 where users receive an initial case confirmation and priority level assignment within 4 business hours.
